items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Lee and I became great friends through the years

ctx.x: Lee. Lee was younger than Prez. And it's a funny thing. Lee and I became great friends through the years, but Prez always seemed... He called me Joe. I never did understand that. But you know, I didn't read much into it. Because I remember one time I saw Lester in Kansas City, and he was playing with the master...one of the masters...King Oliver. He was playing in King Oliver's band.
He did? Lester played with King Oliver?
